title: The unit row for Back-Alley Bar is clipped: Unsung Hero and Ravenbloom Student appear only as a thin sliver at the bottom-right edge of the battlefield panel in both 28.png and 29.png, essentially invisible. The monkey's step-29 click timing out on a locator is consistent with a board element not being reachable/visible.
expected: Both 28.png and 29.png show Back-Alley Bar's player-side unit row as a ~20px sliver at the bottom-right of the panel; the two units (Unsung Hero, Ravenbloom Student, present in bfZones per trace) are unreadable. Source cause in /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/apps/riftbound-app/public/css/gameplay.css: `.bf-units .card { height: 126px }` (lines 490-493) is placed inside `.bf-units { flex: 1 1 56px; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto }` (lines 1143-1155), inside `.battlefield { overflow: hidden }` (line 915-927), inside `.battlefield-row { min-height: 180px }` (line 109-119) of a fixed 1080px logical canvas. After row padding (12px), bf-body padding (8px), header, divider and two stacked .bf-units rows, each unit row gets ~40px for a 126px card, so units are always clipped to a sliver requiring scroll inside a tiny box (board.js:133-139 renders them into these rows). The step-29 timeout linkage is unverifiable (locator truncated), but the clipping defect itself is confirmed.
